articles.title: Tea break & an alert driver: How Kailash pilgrims narrowly escaped Nepal floods
articles.summary: Twenty-eight pilgrims from three Indian states safely returned home after escaping Nepal's devastating flash floods. A brief tea break and a ten-minute delay proved crucial in saving their lives.

articles.title: Influencer who died after being ‘tied to tree, burnt alive’ was 7 weeks pregnant
articles.summary: A social media influencer died after suffering severe burn injuries. She was allegedly abducted and set on fire near Morinda.

articles.title: 4 days under debris, still alive: How a 97-year-old woman survived Nepal floods
articles.summary: In an inspiring tale of survival, a 97-year-old woman managed to endure four harrowing days trapped in rubble after the catastrophic flash floods in Nepal. Rescue teams are still combing through the obliterated regions for additional survivors.

articles.title: ‘Aise bhi log hote hain life me’: Surya reveals Samson’s response after being dropped
articles.summary: Suryakumar Yadav spotlighted the encouraging response from Sanju Samson after he was left out of the 2026 World Cup roster. Samson's commitment to prepare as if he were part of the squad gave the team a considerable confidence boost.

articles.summary: The recent gameplay reveal for GTA 6 has sparked considerable buzz online, especially among gaming enthusiasts. A side mission featured a character reminiscent of Kick streamer Neon, who shared his thrill at possibly inspiring the game's development.

articles.title: Is the viral video really Kai Cenat being assaulted by police? Here’s the truth
articles.summary: A misidentified viral video showing a police altercation has led many to erroneously believe that streamer Kai Cenat is involved. The clip, which actually depicts a traffic stop in Arkansas, features a man who resisted an officer's commands.

articles.title: Kim Jong UN shakes up North Korea’s military, dismisses defence minister No Kwang Chol
articles.summary: North Korea has shaken up its military hierarchy by removing the defense minister, a move approved by Kim Jong Un in a recent leadership meeting. This change mirrors advancements at the nation's weapons research center, which has introduced new combat weapon systems.

articles.title: Karnataka PG MDS 2026: KEA activates verification slip download link for Clause A, Y candidates
articles.summary: The Karnataka Examinations Authority (KEA) has enabled candidates under Clause A and Clause Y to download their verification slips for Karnataka PG MDS 2026. Eligible candidates can access the slips online after completing registration and fee payment.

articles.title: AIAPGET 2026 re-exam admit card released for 49 candidates: Direct link to download hall ticket here
articles.summary: The National Testing Agency has released AIAPGET 2026 re-examination admit cards. These hall tickets are for 49 candidates affected by a power failure in Jaipur.

articles.title: ‘Avengers: Endgame: Encore’ scores 77 million views in the first 24 hours
articles.summary: In an impressive feat, the Avengers: Endgame: Encore trailer accumulated seventy-seven million views on its first day, demonstrating intense fan enthusiasm for the impending Doomsday release. The Encore version is set to appear in theaters worldwide on September twenty-fifth, and fans will be treated to an exclusive look at the Avengers: Doomsday, which is scheduled for worldwide release on December eighteenth, showcasing a new antagonist..

articles.title: Nimisha opens up about 14 kg weight-loss transformation
articles.summary: To prepare for her character in 'Babita Singh Reporting', actress Nimisha Sajayan put on fourteen kilograms, but the challenge of shedding that weight afterwards was immense. She faced exhaustion, mood fluctuations, and frustration during the journey.

articles.title: Harry Styles mentions Taylor Swift during a recent concert
articles.summary: During a recent concert at Madison Square Garden, Harry Styles made a subtle nod to Taylor Swift's wedding with NFL star Travis Kelce. Their past romance inspired Swift's famous track 'Style.' Though Styles received an invitation, he couldn't attend due to prior commitments, while his fiancée, Zoë Kravitz, represented him at the wedding..

articles.title: 'No hidden meaning': Did RGV take dig at Yash's 'Toxic' again?
articles.summary: Filmmaker Ram Gopal Varma's recent social media posts have drawn attention from internet users. Many interpret his remarks as indirect criticisms of Yash's film 'Toxic'.
